about.title: Oakland Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: Grief does not run on a schedule, but a wrongful death claim in California does. Oakland recorded 28 traffic deaths in 2025, many along stretches of International Boulevard, I-580, and I-880 that residents drive every day. Behind each of those numbers is a household in Alameda County trying to figure out what comes next. A wrongful death action is the civil path for that household. It is entirely separate from any police investigation or criminal charge, and it can move forward whether or not the district attorney files anything. Under California law, the right to bring the claim belongs first to a surviving spouse or domestic partner and children, then to certain dependents and heirs. Families generally have two years from the date of death to file, and far less time if a city, county, or state agency may share responsibility. LawProactive is not a law firm. We simply match you with an independent Oakland-area attorney who can review your situation, explain your options, and take the paperwork off your plate while you focus on your family.

whyChoose.title: Why Oakland Families Turn to LawProactive

items.title: Clarity on who can file
items.desc: California limits standing to a spouse or domestic partner and children first, then certain dependents and heirs. An attorney can confirm where your family fits before anything is filed.

items.title: Deadlines handled early
items.desc: The general filing window is two years from the date of death, but claims against a government entity such as the City of Oakland or Caltrans carry a much shorter clock. Getting connected promptly protects those rights.

items.title: Every loss accounted for
items.desc: Recoverable losses reach beyond funeral and burial expenses to the financial support your loved one would have provided and the love, companionship, and guidance your family has lost. Contingency fees mean nothing is owed unless there is a recovery.

items.question: The crash that killed my family member happened on I-880 in Oakland. Does it matter that a freeway was involved?
items.answer: It can. Freeway collisions sometimes involve commercial vehicles, multiple drivers, or questions about roadway maintenance by a state agency. If a public entity may share fault, the deadline to file a claim is much shorter than the standard two years, so it helps to speak with an attorney soon.

items.question: Do we have to wait for the Oakland Police or the Alameda County District Attorney to finish before filing?
items.answer: No. A wrongful death claim is a civil action and stands on its own, apart from any criminal investigation or prosecution. Families often begin the civil process while the criminal side is still pending, and an attorney can request records as they become available.

items.question: What does LawProactive charge to connect us with an attorney?
items.answer: Nothing. LawProactive is a free connection service, not a law firm. The independent attorneys in our network work on contingency, which means they are paid only if your family recovers compensation.
